# function: states_statemachinealias

Builds the ARN for `states` `statemachinealias`:

```
arn:${Partition}:states:${Region}:${Account}:stateMachine:${StateMachineName}:${StateMachineAliasName}
```

The partition, region and account fields come from the configuration file (`.arn.hcl`, or the path in `ARN_CONFIG`). The remaining placeholders are the arguments, in template order.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# arn:aws:states:ap-northeast-1:111111111111:stateMachine:state-machine-name:state-machine-alias-name
output "states_statemachinealias" {
  value = provider::arn::states_statemachinealias("state-machine-name", "state-machine-alias-name")
}
```

## Signature

<!-- signature generated by tfplugindocs -->
```text
states_statemachinealias(state_machine_name string, state_machine_alias_name string, options map of string...) string
```

## Arguments

<!-- arguments generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `state_machine_name` (String) Value for `${StateMachineName}` in the ARN template.
1. `state_machine_alias_name` (String) Value for `${StateMachineAliasName}` in the ARN template.
<!-- variadic argument generated by tfplugindocs -->
1. `options` (Variadic, Map of String) Optional overrides: `account` (the name of an `account` block in the configuration file), `account_id` (a literal account id), `region` and `partition`. At most one options map may be given. An unrecognized key, or a value set to an empty string, is an error; omit an option, or set it to `null`, to use the default.
